lead: Up to 12 photos on one side, text and one button on the other. A switch swaps the sides.
bodytext:
The collage adjusts to the number of photos. One photo fills the column, two sit side by side, and an odd last photo spans the full row. Nothing needs changing when you add or remove a photo.

Each frame has its own ratio, so photos of different shapes still fit together. The frame that spans a row uses a wider ratio, so it does not tower over the text.
